profile: 8-bit SDR 4:2:0, default precision; synthetic 60 FPS equivalent payload budgets
method: candidate / baseline / candidate / baseline; 100 samples plus 20 warmup per case in each run; serialized offscreen decode and conversion; no host PC
interpretation: Correctness passed on the physical A12. Substantial between-run timing variability prevents a reliable speedup claim. At 500 Mbps both candidate runs have higher decode and total-wall p95 than both baseline runs. Simulator percentage gains are not validated as A12 gains.
